summary: Joel Shute, 36, of Glenwood Springs killed in a large avalanche near Chair Mountain in the Marble area; his body was located about 11:30 a.m. and recovered by helicopter by West Elk Search and Rescue with the Colorado Avalanche Information Center; a skier and a splitboarder were also caught in the same slide - the splitboarder hiked out to get help and the skier was rescued by helicopter, both injured and transported for medical treatment
responding_agency: West Elk Search and Rescue; Colorado Avalanche Information Center
notes: Date stated in article (Friday, March 17); ninth Colorado avalanche death of the 2022-23 season per article context [merge 2026-09-15 run616: HotRR corroborates — Friday-afternoon avalanche in upper Rapid Creek SW of Marble; two men extricated and transported; third man (Joel Thomas Shute, 36) recovered Saturday morning from ~4 ft of avalanche debris.] SnowBrains URL appended (run 691; parent-opened — upper Rapid Creek CAIC-detail account, matches Joel Shute Chair Mountain avalanche). | Merge run 929: UN story identifies survivor Jacob Dalbey (InReach SOS ~5:55pm 3/17, helo rescue ~1am 3/18); deceased companion recovered under 3 ft of debris 3/18; dog Ullr survived the slide.
